activity.notes: Madero issued the Plan de San Luis dated 5 October 1910, calling for armed uprising from 20 November 1910; this 1910–1911 year-granularity Activity represents his leadership of the anti-Díaz revolutionary movement leading to the 1911 overthrow. It is activity IN Mexico, not presidential governance and not a claim to have controlled all of Mexico during the uprising. Boundaries are years only; no exact personal leadership start/end days are asserted.
